reason: PURE. First thing I looked at was 'fully chelated, no magnesium oxide' and the batch QR with a named ISO 17025 lab, which is what I check for anyway. Citrate upsets my stomach, so I'd skip the Complex and try one box of the bisglycinate at about $1 a day.
objection: I already have a drawer of half-used bottles, so I'm not sure I'll stick with it. I also can't tell yet if the QR report is real until I scan it, and 200 mg per sachet is two capsules, so I'd want to see the actual lab report.
would_change_my_mind: The QR report not opening to a real batch result from a named lab, or the label showing anything other than clean bisglycinate with no oxide.
